candidate_policy.presentation: Established nutrition, early food evidence, possible support, or studied with mixed/no clear benefit.
candidate_policy.decision: Include sensible ordinary-food hypotheses even when symptom evidence is indirect. The research_only legacy evidence value means exploratory, not hidden from food browsing.
candidate_policy.distinction: Viewing a candidate does not enrol a user in research or authorise sharing health records.
candidate_policy.eligibility: A supported food-family identity can qualify a candidate without complete micronutrient data. It cannot qualify an exact nutrient claim or invent a nutrient amount.
candidate_policy.no_clear_benefit: Retain mixed and null findings visibly. Lower-priority observation candidates are not presented as likely remedies.
candidate_policy.doses: Use ordinary, adjustable portions; trial doses are evidence metadata and never automatic serving instructions.
candidate_policy.promotion: No automatic evidence upgrade from likes, self-reported improvement or exposure count.
candidate_policy.filter_precedence: Default candidate browsing includes every listed evidence category, with its label and priority. An explicit user evidence filter can narrow it; established-nutrition-only views must not masquerade as all candidates.

windows.same_day_with_baseline: Time-stamped symptom before and after; record pain medicine and natural symptom timing.
windows.same_meal_followup: Meal satisfaction/hunger after eating; not a calorie-suppression objective.
windows.same_day: Practical feasibility and regular eating that day.
windows.sleep_next_morning: Next-morning recall linked to prior-evening intake; inspect repeated nights and other sleep influences.
windows.bowel_daily_weekly: Daily stool/comfort measures with weekly summaries over an initially proposed 2–4 weeks.
windows.matched_cycle_windows: Comparable prospectively observed windows across cycles; no immediate-effect assumption.
windows.symptom_daily_weekly: Daily symptom frequency/bother with weekly summaries; account for treatment and stage changes.
windows.pattern_weekly: Weekly pattern, feasibility and outcome observations, with component exposure retained.
windows.nutrition_pattern_weeks: Dietary coverage/adherence over weeks; not a clinical nutrient-status test.
windows.long_term_external_outcome: App measures adherence/tolerance. Bone or clinical outcomes need a separate suitably designed study.

interpretation: Windows are proposed analysis design, not validated onset times.
A skipped outcome is missing, not no effect.
A scan/save is not an exposure.
Retain no-change, worsening and withdrawal observations.
Self-reported benefit and raw symptom change are distinct.
No automatic public confidence upgrade; account for repeated measures, selection, missingness and multiple comparisons.
No public catalogue row contains personal health observations.
Shared meals and multiple simultaneous candidates create joint exposures; never credit every ingredient independently for one outcome.

rules: May exist without an exposure to represent not_tried or declined.
Population research requires its own current consent reference and study pseudonym; personal tracking does not imply study enrolment.
Research refusal is not itself a health research record to export.
Keep identity linkage outside public foods and outside analysis exports.

observation_design.response_state_owner: private_attempt_record; preserve state transitions and their times rather than overwriting history

rules: Offer paired tolerance checks; unanswered remains missing and must not prevent the user logging food.
Do not classify a bowel exposure as beneficial from frequency alone when companion tolerance outcomes are missing.
More stools are not automatically better. Stool-form categories have a desired range, not a monotonically improving direction.

dietary_coverage.scale: known/estimated/unknown contribution from compatible food data

study_match_contract.rule: A shared food name does not imply matched exposure or effect. Unknown metadata cannot support a dose-matched claim; study amounts are never default servings.

deployment.note: production_enabled allows candidate discovery only; draft review_state does not imply verified symptom benefit. Meal/pattern definitions are not assigned to isolated products.
